ip-mode.name: ip-mode
ip-mode.help: Method by which users of this SSL-VPN tunnel obtain IP addresses.

options.name: range
options.help: Use the IP addresses available for all SSL-VPN users as defined by the SSL settings command.

options.name: user-group
options.help: Use the IP addresses associated with individual users or user groups (usually from external auth servers).

options.name: dhcp
options.help: Use IP addresses obtained from external DHCP server.

dhcp-ip-overlap.name: dhcp-ip-overlap
dhcp-ip-overlap.help: Configure overlapping DHCP IP allocation assignment.

options.name: use-new
options.help: Assign DHCP lease to new client and remove old client lease.

options.name: use-old
options.help: Preserve previous client IP allocation and disconnect new client.

auto-connect.name: auto-connect
auto-connect.help: Enable/disable automatic connect by client when system is up.

keep-alive.name: keep-alive
keep-alive.help: Enable/disable automatic reconnect for FortiClient connections.

save-password.name: save-password
save-password.help: Enable/disable FortiClient saving the user's password.

ip-pools.name: ip-pools
ip-pools.help: IPv4 firewall source address objects reserved for SSL-VPN tunnel mode clients.

exclusive-routing.name: exclusive-routing
exclusive-routing.help: Enable/disable all traffic go through tunnel only.

split-tunneling-routing-negate.name: split-tunneling-routing-negate
split-tunneling-routing-negate.help: Enable to negate split tunneling routing address.

split-tunneling-routing-address.name: split-tunneling-routing-address
split-tunneling-routing-address.help: IPv4 SSL-VPN tunnel mode firewall address objects that override firewall policy destination addresses to control split-tunneling access.

dhcp-ra-giaddr.name: dhcp-ra-giaddr
dhcp-ra-giaddr.help: Relay agent gateway IP address to use in the giaddr field of DHCP requests.

ipv6-pools.name: ipv6-pools
ipv6-pools.help: IPv6 firewall source address objects reserved for SSL-VPN tunnel mode clients.

ipv6-exclusive-routing.name: ipv6-exclusive-routing
ipv6-exclusive-routing.help: Enable/disable all IPv6 traffic go through tunnel only.

ipv6-split-tunneling-routing-negate.name: ipv6-split-tunneling-routing-negate
ipv6-split-tunneling-routing-negate.help: Enable to negate IPv6 split tunneling routing address.

ipv6-split-tunneling-routing-address.name: ipv6-split-tunneling-routing-address
ipv6-split-tunneling-routing-address.help: IPv6 SSL-VPN tunnel mode firewall address objects that override firewall policy destination addresses to control split-tunneling access.

dhcp6-ra-linkaddr.name: dhcp6-ra-linkaddr
dhcp6-ra-linkaddr.help: Relay agent IPv6 link address to use in DHCP6 requests.

client-src-range.name: client-src-range
client-src-range.help: Allow client to add source range for the tunnel traffic.

display-bookmark.name: display-bookmark
display-bookmark.help: Enable to display the web portal bookmark widget.

user-bookmark.name: user-bookmark
user-bookmark.help: Enable to allow web portal users to create their own bookmarks.

allow-user-access.name: allow-user-access
allow-user-access.help: Allow user access to SSL-VPN applications.
allow-user-access.default: web ftp smb sftp telnet ssh vnc rdp ping

default-protocol.name: default-protocol
default-protocol.help: Application type that is set by default.

user-group-bookmark.name: user-group-bookmark
user-group-bookmark.help: Enable to allow web portal users to create bookmarks for all users in the same user group.

security.name: security
security.help: Security mode for RDP connection (default = any).

options.name: any
options.help: Allow the server to choose the type of security.

preconnection-id.name: preconnection-id
preconnection-id.help: The numeric ID of the RDP source (0-4294967295).

preconnection-blob.name: preconnection-blob
preconnection-blob.help: An arbitrary string which identifies the RDP source.

load-balancing-info.name: load-balancing-info
load-balancing-info.help: The load balancing information or cookie which should be provided to the connection broker.

restricted-admin.name: restricted-admin
restricted-admin.help: Enable/disable restricted admin mode for RDP.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable restricted admin mode for RDP.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable restricted admin mode for RDP.

sso-credential-sent-once.name: sso-credential-sent-once
sso-credential-sent-once.help: Single sign-on credentials are only sent once to remote server.

options.name: enable
options.help: Single sign-on credentials are only sent once to remote server.

options.name: disable
options.help: Single sign-on credentials are sent to remote server for every HTTP request.

display-connection-tools.name: display-connection-tools
display-connection-tools.help: Enable to display the web portal connection tools widget.

display-history.name: display-history
display-history.help: Enable to display the web portal user login history widget.

focus-bookmark.name: focus-bookmark
focus-bookmark.help: Enable to prioritize the placement of the bookmark section over the quick-connection section in the SSL-VPN application.

display-status.name: display-status
display-status.help: Enable to display the web portal status widget.

rewrite-ip-uri-ui.name: rewrite-ip-uri-ui
rewrite-ip-uri-ui.help: Rewrite contents for URI contains IP and /ui/ (default = disable).

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable contents rewrite for URI contains "IP-address/ui/".

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable contents rewrite for URI contains "IP-address/ui/".

custom-lang.name: custom-lang
custom-lang.help: Change the web portal display language. Overrides config system global set language. You can use config system custom-language and execute system custom-language to add custom language files.

smb-ntlmv1-auth.name: smb-ntlmv1-auth
smb-ntlmv1-auth.help: Enable support of NTLMv1 for Samba authentication.

use-sdwan.name: use-sdwan
use-sdwan.help: Use SD-WAN rules to get output interface.

prefer-ipv6-dns.name: prefer-ipv6-dns
prefer-ipv6-dns.help: Prefer to query IPv6 DNS server first if enabled.

clipboard.name: clipboard
clipboard.help: Enable to support RDP/VPC clipboard functionality.

host-check.name: host-check
host-check.help: Type of host checking performed on endpoints.

options.name: av
options.help: AntiVirus software recognized by the Windows Security Center.

options.name: fw
options.help: Firewall software recognized by the Windows Security Center.

options.name: av-fw
options.help: AntiVirus and firewall software recognized by the Windows Security Center.

host-check-interval.name: host-check-interval
host-check-interval.help: Periodic host check interval. Value of 0 means disabled and host checking only happens when the endpoint connects.

host-check-policy.name: host-check-policy
host-check-policy.help: One or more policies to require the endpoint to have specific security software.

limit-user-logins.name: limit-user-logins
limit-user-logins.help: Enable to limit each user to one SSL-VPN session at a time.

options.name: allow
options.help: Allow connection when client MAC address is matched.

options.name: deny
options.help: Deny connection when client MAC address is matched.

name.name: name
name.help: Client MAC address check rule name.

os-check.name: os-check
os-check.help: Enable to let the FortiGate decide action based on client OS.

customize-forticlient-download-url.name: customize-forticlient-download-url
customize-forticlient-download-url.help: Enable support of customized download URL for FortiClient.

skip-check-for-unsupported-os.name: skip-check-for-unsupported-os
skip-check-for-unsupported-os.help: Enable to skip host check if client OS does not support it.

skip-check-for-browser.name: skip-check-for-browser
skip-check-for-browser.help: Enable to skip host check for browser support.

hide-sso-credential.name: hide-sso-credential
hide-sso-credential.help: Enable to prevent SSO credential being sent to client.

domains.name: domains
domains.help: Split DNS domains used for SSL-VPN clients separated by comma.
